column1: # The levels needed to wear items (osrsps.game.WearRequirements). Items not listed need none.
# Columns, tab-separated: the item's gameval name; its levels as skill=level (combat=N for the combat level);
# the OSRS Wiki page the levels are from. Quest requirements are left out: every account has done every quest.
# Built 2026-10-29: the Wiki pages themselves (read 2026-10-29) for every item where osrsreboxed's Wiki-derived
# requirements and the 241 cache's params 434-437 disagree or osrsreboxed has no entry, else osrsreboxed's. Where a
# page states no level, the cache's combat-skill params stand (guessed: they match the Wiki wherever both exist);
# the cache's Crafting/Firemaking params are the levels to make an item, not to wear it, and are left out.
# Tools list only the level to wield them: a pickaxe's Mining level is to mine with it (Wiki, Pickaxe; Codex on #174).
